description: The one definition of the ai_token_volume tiers: Clarify Q7 asks with these bands, a measured volume is placed in a band with these bounds, and Estimate prices a tier from these bounds.
unit: total tokens per month: input and output, including cache reads and cache writes
bounds: min_tokens is inclusive and max_tokens is exclusive; max_tokens null means no upper bound
estimate_basis: Price a tier at both min_tokens and max_tokens and report the range. A tier without max_tokens is priced at min_tokens and reported as a lower bound. A measured volume replaces the tier.
